stddev_max_enrollment FROM `IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL` AS isd JOIN `ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL` AS ata ON isd.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE JOIN `COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS ccso ON isd.TERM_CODE = ccso.TERM_CODE WHERE ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND NOT isd.MAX_ENROLLMENT IS NULL GROUP BY ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC HAVING COUNT(isd.MAX_ENROLLMENT) > 5) SELECT inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, AS sd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' LEFT JOIN `SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT` AS ad ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE) SELECT sc.SCHOOL_NAME, sc.SCHOOL_NAME_IN_COMMENCEMENT_BK, sc.school_max_cip_code, sc.cip_category, ms.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ms.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, ms.stddev_max_enrollment, ms.department_phone FROM SchoolCIP AS sc JOIN MathIAPStats AS ms ON sc.SCHOOL_CODE = = 'Mathematics' AND NOT isd.MAX_ENROLLMENT IS NULL GROUP BY ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC HAVING COUNT(isd.MAX_ENROLLMENT) > 5) SELECT inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, inner_cte.stddev_max_enrollment, ad.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER AS department_phone, sd.SCHOOL_NAME AS school_name FROM inner_cte LEFT JOIN `SIS_DEPARTMENT` AS sd ON WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT s.COURSE, s.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SCHOOL_NAME, c.PROGRAM_CODE, c.PROGRAM_TITLE, c.CATEGORY_CODE, c.CATEGORY_TITLE, c.FOUR_DIGIT_CODE, c.FOUR_DIGIT_TITLE, MIN(c.WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE) OVER (PARTITION BY c.CATEGORY_CODE ORDER BY c.CATEGORY_CODE) AS min_warehouse_load_date, s.DEPARTMENT FROM `SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION` AS s JOIN `CIP` AS c ON c.PROGRAM_CODE = s.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE WHERE s.DEPARTMENT = 6 AND s.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y'), student_counts AS (SELECT msd.DEPARTMENT, msd.STUDENT_YEAR, COUNT(*) AS num_students FROM `MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY` AS msd GROUP BY msd.DEPARTMENT, msd.STUDENT_YEAR), dept_stats AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(sc.num_students) AS avg_students_per_year, MAX(sc.num_students) - MIN(sc.num_students) AS range_students_per_year, VARIANCE(sc.num_students) AS var_students_per_year FROM `SIS_DEPARTMENT` AS sd JOIN student_counts AS sc ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sc.DEPARTMENT WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '17' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT ic.COURSE, ic.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.SCHOOL_NAME, ic.PROGRAM_CODE, ic.PROGRAM_TITLE, ic.CATEGORY_CODE, ic.CATEGORY_TITLE, ic.FOUR_DIGIT_CODE, ic.FOUR_DIGIT_TITLE, ic.min_warehouse_load_date, ds.avg_students_per_year, ds.range_students_per_year, ds.var_students_per_year, sd.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, sd.SCHOOL_CODE FROM inner_cte AS ic JOIN dept_stats AS ds ON ic.DEPARTMENT = ds.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN `SIS_DEPARTMENT` AS sd ON ic.DEPARTMENT = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY ic.CATEGORY_CODE, ic.COURSE

WITH dept_units_stats AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, ccc.TOTAL_UNITS FROM `SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT` AS sad JOIN `SIS_DEPARTMENT` AS sd ON sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN `CIS_COURSE_CATALOG` AS ccc ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccc.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND ccc.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND UPPER(sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME) <> 'MECHANICAL ENGINEERING') SELECT icte.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(icte.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VARIANCE(icte.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(icte.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev, dept_course_counts.Total_Courses FROM inner_cte AS icte JOIN (SELECT SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(*) AS Total_Courses FROM inner_cte GROUP BY SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME) AS dept_course_counts ON icte.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME = dept_course_counts.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME GROUP BY icte.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, dept_course_counts.Total_Courses), math_course_stats AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ccc.SUBJECT_CODE, ccc.TOTAL_UNITS, scd.COURSE, scd.COURSE_DESCRIPTION FROM `SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION` AS scd JOIN `SIS_SUBJECT_CODE` AS ssc ON scd.COURSE = ssc.SUBJECT_CODE JOIN `CIS_COURSE_CATALOG` AS ccc ON ssc.SUBJECT_CODE = ccc.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE ccc.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' AND NOT ccc.total_units IS NULL AND scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics') SELECT i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.COURSE AS course_number, i.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, i.TOTAL_UNITS, dept_stats.avg_total_units, dept_stats.min_total_units, dept_stats.max_total_units, (i.TOTAL_UNITS - dept_stats.avg_total_units) AS deviation_from_avg FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN (SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, MIN(TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units, MAX(TOTAL_UNITS) AS max_total_units FROM inner_cte GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME) AS dept_stats ON i.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dept_stats.DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT dus.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, dus.avg_total_units, dus.total_units_variance, dus.total_units_stddev, dus.Total_Courses, mcs.course_number, mcs.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, mcs.TOTAL_UNITS AS math_course_total_units, mcs.avg_total_units AS math_avg_total_units, mcs.min_total_units AS math_min_total_units, mcs.max_total_units AS math_max_total_units, mcs.deviation_from_avg AS math_deviation_from_avg FROM dept_units_stats AS dus LEFT JOIN math_course_stats AS mcs ON dus.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME = mcs.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY dus.total_units_variance DESC, mcs.deviation_from_avg DESC

WITH school_avg_units AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT ssc.SCHOOL_NAME, ccc.TOTAL_UNITS FROM `SIS_SUBJECT_CODE` AS ssc JOIN `CIS_COURSE_CATALOG` AS ccc ON ssc.SUBJECT_CODE = ccc.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE NOT ccc.TOTAL_UNITS IS NULL), schools_with_physics AS (SELECT DISTINCT ssc.SCHOOL_NAME FROM `SIS_SUBJECT_CODE` AS ssc JOIN `CIS_COURSE_CATALOG` AS ccc ON ssc.SUBJECT_CODE = ccc.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE swp.SCHOOL_NAME WHERE swp.SCHOOL_NAME IS NULL GROUP BY icte.SCHOOL_NAME HAVING COUNT(icte.TOTAL_UNITS) > 0), dept_year_stats AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, ccc.ACADEMIC_YEAR, AVG(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VARIANCE(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM `SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT` AS sad JOIN `SIS_DEPARTMENT` AS sd ON sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN `CIS_COURSE_CATALOG` AS ccc ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccc.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND ccc.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND UPPER(sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME) <> 'MECHANICAL ENGINEERING' GROUP BY sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, ccc.ACADEMIC_YEAR) SELECT icte.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, icte.avg_total_units, icte.total_units_variance, icte.total_units_stddev, sd.SCHOOL_NAME, sad.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER FROM inner_cte AS icte LEFT JOIN `SIS_DEPARTMENT` AS sd ON d.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.ACADEMIC_YEAR, d.avg_total_units, d.total_units_variance, d.total_units_stddev, d.SCHOOL_NAME AS DEPT_SCHOOL_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER FROM school_avg_units AS s WITH StudentInfo AS (SELECT sd.DEPT_NAME_IN_COMMENCEMENT_BK AS department_name, sd.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME AS department_full_name, msd.FULL_NAME AS student_full_name, msd.EMAIL_ADDRESS AS student_email_address, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY sd.SCHOOL_CODE) AS school_code_dense_rank, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM `MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY` AS msd JOIN `SIS_DEPARTMENT` AS sd ON msd.DEPARTMENT = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE msd.STUDENT_YEAR = 'G' AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18'), DepartmentCIPStats AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, MAX(scd.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) - MIN(scd.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS cip_code_range, VARIANCE(scd.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS cip_code_variance FROM `SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION` AS scd JOIN `SIS_DEPARTMENT` AS sd ON scd.DEPARTMENT = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND NOT scd.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE IS NULL AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME), CombinedResults AS (SELECT si.department_name, si.department_full_name, si.student_full_name, si.student_email_address, si.school_code_dense_rank, dcs.cip_code_range, dcs.cip_code_variance FROM StudentInfo AS si LEFT JOIN DepartmentCIPStats AS dcs ON si.DEPARTMENT_CODE = dcs.DEPARTMENT_CODE UNION ALL SELECT NULL AS department_name, dcs.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME AS department_full_name, NULL AS student_full_name, NULL AS student_email_address, NULL AS school_code_dense_rank, dcs.cip_code_range, dcs.cip_code_variance FROM DepartmentCIPStats AS dcs WHERE NOT dcs.DEPARTMENT_CODE IN (SELECT DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM StudentInfo)) SELECT department_name, department_full_name, student_full_name, student_email_address, school_code_dense_rank, cip_code_range, cip_code_variance FROM CombinedResults ORDER BY department_full_name, student_full_name

WITH inner_cte1 AS (SELECT SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME, VARIANCE(TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_students_variance, STDDEV(TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_students_stddev, SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM `TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED` JOIN `SIS_DEPARTMENT` ON TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN `SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION` ON SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE = SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.DEPARTMENT WHERE SIS_DEPARTMENT.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.COURSE_LEVEL = 'G' AND NOT SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME IN ('Chemistry', 'Biology') GROUP BY SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE), variance_stats AS (SELECT inner_cte1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte1.enrolled_students_variance, inner_cte1.enrolled_students_stddev, CASE WHEN inner_cte1.enrolled_students_variance > avg_stats.avg_variance * 1.2 THEN 'HIGH_VARIANCE' WHEN inner_cte1.enrolled_students_variance < avg_stats.avg_variance * 0.8 THEN 'LOW_VARIANCE' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS variance_category, inner_cte1.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM inner_cte1 CROSS JOIN (SELECT AVG(enrolled_students_variance) AS avg_variance FROM inner_cte1) AS avg_stats), inner_cte2 AS (SELECT sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, STDDEV_SAMP(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) / NULLIF(AVG(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation, sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM `SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT` AS sad JOIN `SIS_DEPARTMENT` AS sd ON sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN `COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS ccso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE UPPER(sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME) = 'MECHANICAL ENGINEERING' AND ccso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2024 GROUP BY sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE), admin_stats AS (SELECT inner_cte2.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte2.coefficient_of_variation, sad.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER, inner_cte2.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM inner_cte2 JOIN `SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT` AS sad ON inner_cte2.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME = sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT vs.DEPARTMENT_NAME, vs.enrolled_students_variance, vs.enrolled_students_stddev, vs.variance_category, ast.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, ast.coefficient_of_variation, ast.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER FROM variance_stats AS vs JOIN admin_stats AS ast ON vs.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ast.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY vs.enrolled_students_variance DESC

base_solution_anchor.base_sql:
SELECT MIN(c.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS min_cip, COUNT(DISTINCT c.DEPARTMENT) AS dept_count, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME
FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION c
JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON c.DEPARTMENT = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE
WHERE d.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering'
  AND d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y'
  AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mechanical Engineering'

persistent_recovery_advisory_draft.base_sql:
SELECT 
    MIN(cip.PROGRAM_CODE) AS min_cip_program_code,
    COUNT(DISTINCT scd.DEPARTMENT) AS total_departments,
    MAX(mdh.DLC_NAME) AS administrative_department_name
FROM CIP cip
JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON cip.PROGRAM_CODE = scd.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE
JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON scd.DEPARTMENT = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE
JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION fo ON sd.DLC_KEY = fo.DLC_KEY
JOIN MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY mdh ON fo.DLC_KEY = mdh.DLC_KEY
WHERE scd.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering'
  AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y'
  AND scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mechanical Engineering'
